gold_label_and_stored_reply_posthoc_diag.limitations: Substring is NOT accuracy; agreement on a publisher answer phrase does not prove correct reasoning. The alias is qualitative unvalidated, not added to strict score.

decision: No QLoRA training. More search-read affordance can slightly improve action activation without task accuracy. HotpotQA answer serialization is known from earlier source-shift runs, but prior GAIA v7 serializer and grammar interventions failed due non-finalization; no further format-only pilot justified.
generalization_boundary: Public HotpotQA validation and local search/read proxy only. No independent hidden GAIA gain. Repetitions and model pretraining overlap remain unverified.
